disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.subheading: Lali didn't read this, but you should
disclaimer.bodyText: $Lali was created by lab-engineered rubber ducks who have no knowledge of economics or monetary systems. As such, $Lali has no value and is a meme coin meant for entertainment purposes only. Do not risk money you are afraid of losing. Just like a duck bobbing in the water, the price may go up or it may go down. We take no responsibility for the price action.

hero.heading: Lali-lore
hero.subheading: All about Lali's dramatic hero-origin arc
hero.bodyText: On the planet of Lurdonia, a group of scientists engineered an army of mutated rubber ducks, primed for galactic conquest. Yet, the Lali's wanted no part in global domination, and were desperate to escape. The Lali's devised a plan to leave the planet of Lurdonia and travel by spaceship to earth. But there was a problem, the Lali's had no money to build a ship - until they discovered crypto...
